champion.promotion_authority: User explicitly requested promotion of the winning model and a complete ranking.
champion.metric: Arithmetic mean of eight monthly MAE / mean-corrected linear-interpolation MAE ratios; lower is better
champion.model: Quantile residual ensemble; fixed physical scaling, ordinary/ratio fitting objectives and validation-selected seed means.
champion.blend_rule: Within each fold, preceding selection dates choose fixed rich-linear pair or equal top2/3/4/6 family blend; ratio-trained experts for this champion.
champion.components: Often equal MLP/temporal-CNN/analog-2D-CNN; February rich-linear/MLP, March six experts. Exact fold selections are in the recovery archive.
champion.selection_scope: Best observed developmental recipe after comparing aggregate test scores; not a blind test or a preselected across-campaign winner.

best_pre_test_policy.note: Per-fold choices use prior data; selecting this policy across campaigns is still developmental.

champion.inference_entrypoint_status: Research champion registry; an all-history inference refit of this recipe has not been made.
